sme.cicReportHelpText: A CIC (Credit Information Centre) report is required to assess creditworthiness. You can obtain it from the State Bank of Vietnam's CIC portal.
sme.howToObtainCic: How to obtain your CIC report
sme.cicStep1: Visit the State Bank of Vietnam CIC portal
sme.cicStep2: Log in with your business tax code
sme.cicStep3: Request a full credit report (Báo cáo tín dụng)
sme.cicStep4: Download and upload the PDF here
sme.step1Why: To verify the company's internal regulations, ownership structure, and legal registration status.
sme.step1How: Retrieve the official signed copy of your Company Charter and the Certificate of Business Registration.
sme.step2Why: To evaluate the ongoing transaction volume and operational consistency of your company over the past 2 years.
sme.step2How: Gather all monthly VAT declarations and submission confirmations (48 files total) and compress them into a single .zip file.
sme.step3Why: To inspect the company's annual financial health, profitability, assets, and liabilities.
sme.step3How: Export the official Annual Financial Statement (Form B02-DN) submitted for the last fiscal year.
sme.step4Why: To review the active monthly transaction history and daily sales records for automated cashflow profiling.
sme.step4How: Export the last 12 months of electronic invoice data (issued and received) from your tax authority portal.
sme.step5Why: To inspect creditworthiness and past repayment performance using official central credit registry records.
sme.step5How: Visit the State Bank of Vietnam CIC portal, log in with your business credentials, request a business credit report, and download it as PDF.
